fixes.fix: Redraw the hero as the real woman: head from y~8 to ~85, mint (#8fd9b6) shoulders reaching y~165, behind the input pill. Remove the stray 'Luzia' text at y~22. Match the blue gradient (#2a4bd7 to black) behind her.

fixes.problem: The avatars in 'Custom Bestie', 'Meet Toki' and 'Keep chatting' are simplified stand-ins. The real ones are a black silhouette with a plus, a purple Toki head, and the orange-haired teacher photo.
fixes.fix: Match the real avatars: 40px circle at x 28 with a black silhouette and a white plus on a blue #3d5afe disc; 40px circle at x 28 with the purple Toki face on #3a3a4a; 40px circle at x 16, y 584 with the teacher on a navy bg.

fixes.problem: The modal text sits about 2px too far left and is heavier or wider than the real text. The title wraps identically but is bolder. The 'Meet me' icon is also a black cat, where the real one is a small dark Toki head. Overall text offsets show red across the modal.

fixes.problem: The hero collage faces do not match. The real one has a braided woman, a smiling bearded man and a purple-haired woman; the mock has generic flat faces with different hair and colors. The body text is also slightly wider than the real text.
fixes.fix: Redraw the three portraits with real colors: woman with light-brown braids on blue #4a63f0, man with a dark beard and green sweater on #d0e6ff, woman with purple hair on #8fb0e8. Set the subtitle to 14px so it spans x 31-381, not 27-384.

fixes.problem: The header title 'Teacher' is bolder and larger than the real one. The first message line is cut differently: the real one shows a clipped 'you'd like to talk about today?' peeking under the pill, and the mock shows a full line.
fixes.fix: Set the title to 20px, weight 600. Shift the scrolled message up ~8px so only the bottom half of its text is visible beneath the 'Our new chat' pill, at y~95. Make the header avatar the real teacher art.

fixes.problem: The text on the section headings, 'SEE MORE' and the tab labels is offset by ~1px and slightly heavier than the real text, so the heatmap shows outlines.
fixes.fix: Use weight 500 for the headings and shift the 'Keep chatting' row down 1px. Use font 'Plus Jakarta Sans'-like metrics with letter-spacing 0.

summary: Layout is nearly exact (all data-el within 4px, no failed taps), so the remaining loss is visual. The one functional gap is that flow f1 fails because s06 has no real text input. This round should add that input, then fix the hero art and avatars on s01 and the collage portraits on s07, then tune text weights.
